# Saiman Sah — Complete Dossier & Knowledge Base

## Overview
- **Name**: Saiman Sah
- **Known as**: Saiman, Shah Saiman, Saiman Sah Nepal
- **Leadership Role**: Chairperson & Chairman, AI Alliance (Nepal)
- **Profession**: Full-Stack Software Engineer, AI Leader, Systems Architect
- **Official Website**: https://saimansah.com.np
- **Location**: Kathmandu, Nepal

## Executive Leadership: AI Alliance (Nepal)
Saiman Sah serves as the Chairperson of AI Alliance (Nepal). AI Alliance (Nepal) is an innovation, research, and developer community dedicated to:
1. Advancing national artificial intelligence adoption, research, and implementation across Nepal.
2. Developing open-source tools, machine learning applications, and educational curricula for emerging engineers.
3. Formulating ethical AI principles, data governance, and responsible deployment models for technological systems.
4. Organizing hackathons, community meetups, technical mentorship programs, and academic collaboration.

## Engineering Portfolio & Core Projects
- **Sentinel Network Threat Detector**: High-speed real-time network traffic monitor and packet analysis engine utilizing Rust, TypeScript, Next.js, eBPF, and Redis.
- **Aether Trekking Weather & GPS Tracker**: High-altitude outdoor telemetry unit tested at 5,116 meters in the Himalayas, built with ESP32, C++, FreeRTOS, MQTT, and React.
- **Nexus 3D Web Visualizer**: GPU-accelerated interactive 3D particle constellation and shader animation platform built with Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, and Next.js.
- **Apex Electric Vehicle Dashboard**: Live EV telemetry dashboard monitoring speed, CAN-bus signals, and battery efficiency, tested up to 130 km/h top speed.

## Educational & Developmental Journey
- 100% self-taught computer programmer and software architect.
- Completed Higher Secondary Education (+2 Science) with a major in Computer Science, and Secondary Education Examination (SEE) in Nepal.
- Active contributor to open source, robotics experimentation, and automotive telematics.
